The lesion transilluminates well, and no inguinal nodes are palpable. Findings from a testicular scan are normal. The most appropriate management includes

Options: 
A. ultrasonic therapy
B. cryotherapy
C. needle biopsy
D. radiation therapy
E. laser therapy
F. chemotherapy
G. needle aspiration
H. injection with a sclerosing agent
I. surgical repair
J. oral medication
